name.fil: Road and Traffic Accidents (Aksidente sa Daan)

lessons.en: Cross only at pedestrian lanes or overpasses, and look left, right, and left again.
lessons.fil: Tumawid lang sa pedestrian lane o overpass, at tumingin sa kaliwa, kanan, at kaliwa ulit.

lessons.en: Always wear a seatbelt or a standard helmet.
lessons.fil: Laging magsuot ng seatbelt o standard na helmet.

lessons.en: Never ride with a driver who has been drinking, and call 911 if you see a crash.
lessons.fil: Huwag sumakay sa driver na nakainom, at tumawag sa 911 kapag may nakitang aksidente.

question.en: What does a yellow traffic light mean?
question.fil: Ano ang ibig sabihin ng yellow na traffic light?

explain.en: Yellow warns that the light will soon turn red.
explain.fil: Babala ang yellow na malapit nang mag-red ang ilaw.

question.en: Name the government office that issues driver's licenses and registers vehicles.
question.fil: Ano ang opisina ng gobyerno na nagbibigay ng driver's license at nagre-register ng mga sasakyan?

explain.en: The LTO also enforces many road safety laws.
explain.fil: Ipinapatupad din ng LTO ang maraming batas sa kaligtasan sa daan.

question.en: Seatbelts are needed even on short trips.
question.fil: Kailangan ang seatbelt kahit maikli lang ang biyahe.

explain.en: Many crashes happen close to home. RA 8750 requires seatbelt use.
explain.fil: Maraming aksidente ang nangyayari malapit lang sa bahay. Nire-require ng RA 8750 ang paggamit ng seatbelt.

question.en: When there is no sidewalk, walk on the side of the road ____ oncoming traffic.
question.fil: Kapag walang sidewalk, maglakad sa gilid ng daan na ____ sa paparating na sasakyan.

explain.en: Facing traffic lets you see vehicles coming and step aside.
explain.fil: Kapag nakaharap ka sa traffic, nakikita mo ang paparating na sasakyan at makakatabi ka agad.

question.en: Match each Philippine road safety law with its focus.
question.fil: Itugma ang bawat batas sa kaligtasan sa daan sa pokus nito.

pairs.en: Child Safety in Motor Vehicles Act
pairs.fil: Child Safety in Motor Vehicles Act

explain.en: These laws target the biggest risks on Philippine roads.
explain.fil: Tinutugunan ng mga batas na ito ang pinakamalalaking panganib sa mga daan sa Pilipinas.

question.en: Name 3 common causes of road crashes.
question.fil: Magbigay ng 3 karaniwang sanhi ng aksidente sa daan.

show.en: speeding, distracted driving, drunk driving, ignoring traffic signs, reckless overtaking, drowsy driving, poor vehicle maintenance, unsafe crossing, bad weather
show.fil: sobrang bilis, paggamit ng phone habang nagmamaneho, pagmamaneho nang nakainom, hindi pagsunod sa traffic signs, delikadong pag-overtake, pagmamaneho nang inaantok, sirang preno o gulong, maling pagtawid, masamang panahon

explain.en: Most crashes are caused by human choices, which means they can be prevented.
explain.fil: Karamihan ng aksidente ay dahil sa desisyon ng tao, kaya puwede itong maiwasan.

question.en: After a party, your uncle has been drinking and offers to drive you home. What should you do?
question.fil: Pagkatapos ng party, nakainom ang tito mo at nag-alok siyang ihatid ka pauwi. Ano ang dapat mong gawin?

choices.en: Politely refuse and call a parent or another sober adult
choices.fil: Magalang na tumanggi at tumawag sa magulang o ibang adult na hindi nakainom

choices.en: Ask him to drive faster to get home sooner
choices.fil: Pakiusapan siyang bilisan para mabilis makauwi

explain.en: Drunk driving is illegal under RA 10586 and very dangerous.
explain.fil: Bawal ang drunk driving ayon sa RA 10586, at napakadelikado nito.

question.en: Arrange the steps for crossing the road safely.
question.fil: Ayusin ang mga hakbang sa ligtas na pagtawid.

steps.en: Stop at the curb or pedestrian lane
steps.fil: Huminto sa gilid ng daan o pedestrian lane

steps.en: Look left, right, and left again
steps.fil: Tumingin sa kaliwa, kanan, at kaliwa ulit
Pakinggan kung may paparating na sasakyan

steps.en: Wait until the road is clear or the signal says walk
steps.fil: Maghintay hanggang walang sasakyan o hanggang mag-walk ang signal

steps.en: Walk straight across, still watching for vehicles
steps.fil: Tumawid nang diretso habang patuloy na nagbabantay sa sasakyan

explain.en: Stopping and checking gives you time to judge traffic before you step out.
explain.fil: Ang paghinto at pagtingin ay nagbibigay ng oras para matantiya ang traffic bago ka tumawid.

scene.en: A tricycle driver offers to take five students home at once, with two of you sitting on the roof.
scene.fil: Nag-alok ang isang tricycle driver na isakay nang sabay ang limang estudyante, at dalawa sa inyo ay uupo sa bubong.

choices.en: Decline and wait for a safer ride
choices.fil: Tumanggi at maghintay ng mas ligtas na sakay

choices.en: Sit on the edge of the seat

explain.en: Overloading and riding on the roof are illegal and can cause serious falls.
explain.fil: Bawal at delikado ang overloading at pagsakay sa bubong; puwede kang mahulog at masaktan nang malubha.
